candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.long_horizon_snapshot: November 2025 and July 2026 BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag and scope revisions; derived metrics do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability, physical delivery during the interval or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.missing_value: A contract absent from one displayed monthly table is preserved as absent for that snapshot. Missing month values are not imputed as zero and calculations requiring both months are not performed.
scope_guards.gap_metric: A contracted-minus-built gap is arithmetic over rounded snapshot fields. It is not a parcel backlog, forecast, need estimate or contractual milestone assessment.
scope_guards.switching_scope: Ofcom switching guidance describes standard consumer processes; actual eligibility, timing, charges, service continuity and number retention depend on provider, contract and case facts.
scope_guards.contract_scope: Ofcom contract guidance is a general consumer summary rather than legal advice; exact rights depend on customer category, contract date, wording and facts.
scope_guards.enforcement_scope: The One Touch Switch enforcement page records regulatory history and programme conclusions; it does not prove compliance, switching success or entitlement in an individual case.

expansion_rule: For each contract in the union of the November 2025 and July 2026 tables emit twelve records: presence classification; November supplier, contracted and built or explicit absence guards; July supplier, contracted and built or explicit absence guards; contracted delta, built delta, built percentage change or zero/absence guard, average monthly built delta over eight months or absence guard, and contracted-minus-built gap change or absence guard. Append 44 Ofcom switching, contract and enforcement records. Every fifth expanded record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
